def workbook_rows(path: Path, sheet: str | int = 0) -> tuple[int, list[str], list[dict]]:
    workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    worksheet = workbook[workbook.sheetnames[sheet] if isinstance(sheet, int) else sheet]
    worksheet.reset_dimensions()
    raw_rows = list(worksheet.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    workbook.close()
    header_index = None
    best_nonblank = -1
    for index, row in enumerate(raw_rows[:20]):
        nonblank = sum(value is not None for value in row)
        if nonblank > best_nonblank:
            best_nonblank = nonblank
            header_index = index
    if header_index is None:
        return 0, [], []
    headers = [clean_text(value) for value in raw_rows[header_index]]
    records = []
    for row in raw_rows[header_index + 1 :]:
        if not any(value is not None for value in row):
            continue
        records.append(dict(zip(headers, row)))
    return header_index + 1, headers, records

def load_inputs(self) -> None:
        self.log("开始只读加载阶段04、05_v2、06、07及B01正式输入")
        for item in INPUTS:
            path = self.root / item.relative
            if not path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少正式输入：{path}")
            stat = path.stat()
            manifest_row = {
                "阶段": item.stage,
                "输入键": item.key,
                "相对路径": item.relative,
                "工作表": item.sheet,
                "文件大小": stat.st_size,
                "修改时间": datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                "SHA256": _sha256(path),
                "读取状态": "成功",
            }
            self.input_manifest.append(manifest_row)
            if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx":
                self.frames[item.key] = _read_excel(path, item.sheet)
            else:
                # 正式报告必须读取，但不将大段文本复制进输出。
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                if not text.strip():
                    raise ValueError(f"正式报告为空：{path}")
                self.frames[item.key] = pd.DataFrame({"content_length": [len(text)]})
        self.log(f"正式输入加载完成：{len(INPUTS)}个文件")

]

FIVE = PROTECTED[:5]

def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

def record(rel):
    path = H0H / rel
    return {
        "relative_path": rel,
        "exists": path.exists(),
        "size_bytes": path.stat().st_size if path.exists() else -1,
        "sha256": sha(path) if path.exists() else "",
    }

protected_records = [record(x) for x in PROTECTED]
row_sha_counts = {}
row_sha_payload_digests = {}
for rel in PROTECTED[:3]:
    path = H0H / rel
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
    values = [x["row_sha256"] for x in rows]
    row_sha_counts[Path(rel).name] = len(values)
    row_sha_payload_digests[Path(rel).name] = hashlib.sha256(
        ("\n".join(values) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()

def load_inputs(self) -> None:
        self.log("开始只读加载阶段04、05_v2、06、07及B01正式输入")
        for item in INPUTS:
            path = self.root / item.relative
            if not path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少正式输入：{path}")
            stat = path.stat()
            manifest_row = {
                "阶段": item.stage,
                "输入键": item.key,
                "相对路径": item.relative,
                "工作表": item.sheet,
                "文件大小": stat.st_size,
                "修改时间": datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                "SHA256": _sha256(path),
                "读取状态": "成功",
            }
            self.input_manifest.append(manifest_row)
            if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx":
                self.frames[item.key] = _read_excel(path, item.sheet)
            else:
                # 正式报告必须读取，但不将大段文本复制进输出。
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                if not text.strip():
                    raise ValueError(f"正式报告为空：{path}")
                self.frames[item.key] = pd.DataFrame({"content_length": [len(text)]})
        self.log(f"正式输入加载完成：{len(INPUTS)}个文件")

def workbook_rows(path: Path, sheet: str | int = 0) -> tuple[int, list[str], list[dict]]:
    workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    worksheet = workbook[workbook.sheetnames[sheet] if isinstance(sheet, int) else sheet]
    worksheet.reset_dimensions()
    raw_rows = list(worksheet.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    workbook.close()
    header_index = None
    best_nonblank = -1
    for index, row in enumerate(raw_rows[:20]):
        nonblank = sum(value is not None for value in row)
        if nonblank > best_nonblank:
            best_nonblank = nonblank
            header_index = index
    if header_index is None:
        return 0, [], []
    headers = [clean_text(value) for value in raw_rows[header_index]]
    records = []
    for row in raw_rows[header_index + 1 :]:
        if not any(value is not None for value in row):
            continue
        records.append(dict(zip(headers, row)))
    return header_index + 1, headers, records

        self.log("开始只读加载阶段04、05_v2、06、07及B01正式输入")
        for item in INPUTS:
            path = self.root / item.relative
            if not path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少正式输入：{path}")
            stat = path.stat()
            manifest_row = {
                "阶段": item.stage,
                "输入键": item.key,
                "相对路径": item.relative,
                "工作表": item.sheet,
                "文件大小": stat.st_size,
                "修改时间": datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                "SHA256": _sha256(path),
                "读取状态": "成功",
            }
            self.input_manifest.append(manifest_row)
            if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx":
                self.frames[item.key] = _read_excel(path, item.sheet)
            else:
                # 正式报告必须读取，但不将大段文本复制进输出。
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                if not text.strip():
                    raise ValueError(f"正式报告为空：{path}")
                self.frames[item.key] = pd.DataFrame({"content_length": [len(text)]})
        self.log(f"正式输入加载完成：{len(INPUTS)}个文件")

def image_ahash(path: Path) -> str:
    with Image.open(path) as im:
        gray = im.convert("L").resize((8, 8))
        vals = list(gray.get_flattened_data())
    avg = sum(vals) / len(vals)
    bits = "".join("1" if v >= avg else "0" for v in vals)
    return f"{int(bits, 2):016x}"


def image_edge_variance(path: Path) -> float:
    with Image.open(path) as im:
        gray = im.convert("L").resize((min(im.width, 1600), min(im.height, 1600)))
    return float(ImageStat.Stat(gray).var[0])

def load_inputs(self) -> None:
        self.log("开始只读加载阶段04、05_v2、06、07及B01正式输入")
        for item in INPUTS:
            path = self.root / item.relative
            if not path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少正式输入：{path}")
            stat = path.stat()
            manifest_row = {
                "阶段": item.stage,
                "输入键": item.key,
                "相对路径": item.relative,
                "工作表": item.sheet,
                "文件大小": stat.st_size,
                "修改时间": datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                "SHA256": _sha256(path),
                "读取状态": "成功",
            }
            self.input_manifest.append(manifest_row)
            if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx":
                self.frames[item.key] = _read_excel(path, item.sheet)
            else:
                # 正式报告必须读取，但不将大段文本复制进输出。
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                if not text.strip():
                    raise ValueError(f"正式报告为空：{path}")
                self.frames[item.key] = pd.DataFrame({"content_length": [len(text)]})
        self.log(f"正式输入加载完成：{len(INPUTS)}个文件")

def workbook_rows(path: Path, sheet: str | int = 0) -> tuple[int, list[str], list[dict]]:
    workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    worksheet = workbook[workbook.sheetnames[sheet] if isinstance(sheet, int) else sheet]
    worksheet.reset_dimensions()
    raw_rows = list(worksheet.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    workbook.close()
    header_index = None
    best_nonblank = -1
    for index, row in enumerate(raw_rows[:20]):
        nonblank = sum(value is not None for value in row)
        if nonblank > best_nonblank:
            best_nonblank = nonblank
            header_index = index
    if header_index is None:
        return 0, [], []
    headers = [clean_text(value) for value in raw_rows[header_index]]
    records = []
    for row in raw_rows[header_index + 1 :]:
        if not any(value is not None for value in row):
            continue
        records.append(dict(zip(headers, row)))
    return header_index + 1, headers, records

        self.log("开始只读加载阶段04、05_v2、06、07及B01正式输入")
        for item in INPUTS:
            path = self.root / item.relative
            if not path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少正式输入：{path}")
            stat = path.stat()
            manifest_row = {
                "阶段": item.stage,
                "输入键": item.key,
                "相对路径": item.relative,
                "工作表": item.sheet,
                "文件大小": stat.st_size,
                "修改时间": datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                "SHA256": _sha256(path),
                "读取状态": "成功",
            }
            self.input_manifest.append(manifest_row)
            if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx":
                self.frames[item.key] = _read_excel(path, item.sheet)
            else:
                # 正式报告必须读取，但不将大段文本复制进输出。
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                if not text.strip():
                    raise ValueError(f"正式报告为空：{path}")
                self.frames[item.key] = pd.DataFrame({"content_length": [len(text)]})
        self.log(f"正式输入加载完成：{len(INPUTS)}个文件")

def workbook_rows(path: Path, sheet: str | int = 0) -> tuple[int, list[str], list[dict]]:
    workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    worksheet = workbook[workbook.sheetnames[sheet] if isinstance(sheet, int) else sheet]
    worksheet.reset_dimensions()
    raw_rows = list(worksheet.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    workbook.close()
    header_index = None
    best_nonblank = -1
    for index, row in enumerate(raw_rows[:20]):
        nonblank = sum(value is not None for value in row)
        if nonblank > best_nonblank:
            best_nonblank = nonblank
            header_index = index
    if header_index is None:
        return 0, [], []
    headers = [clean_text(value) for value in raw_rows[header_index]]
    records = []
    for row in raw_rows[header_index + 1 :]:
        if not any(value is not None for value in row):
            continue
        records.append(dict(zip(headers, row)))
    return header_index + 1, headers, records

def load_inputs(self) -> None:
        self.log("开始只读加载阶段04、05_v2、06、07及B01正式输入")
        for item in INPUTS:
            path = self.root / item.relative
            if not path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少正式输入：{path}")
            stat = path.stat()
            manifest_row = {
                "阶段": item.stage,
                "输入键": item.key,
                "相对路径": item.relative,
                "工作表": item.sheet,
                "文件大小": stat.st_size,
                "修改时间": datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                "SHA256": _sha256(path),
                "读取状态": "成功",
            }
            self.input_manifest.append(manifest_row)
            if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx":
                self.frames[item.key] = _read_excel(path, item.sheet)
            else:
                # 正式报告必须读取，但不将大段文本复制进输出。
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                if not text.strip():
                    raise ValueError(f"正式报告为空：{path}")
                self.frames[item.key] = pd.DataFrame({"content_length": [len(text)]})
        self.log(f"正式输入加载完成：{len(INPUTS)}个文件")

def build_add_audit(self, master: pd.DataFrame, orders: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """按实际执行订单重建每次ADD前的持仓数量与加权持仓均价。

        阶段05仓位事件会把同一OPEN订单内首个Fill之后的Fill段标成ADD_POSITION，
        因而“每次加仓”必须以05_Order实际执行汇总中的order_position_role=ADD为准。
        仓位事件仅用于取得该订单第一段前与最后一段后的真实持仓数量。
        """

def workbook_rows(path: Path, sheet: str | int = 0) -> tuple[int, list[str], list[dict]]:
    workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    worksheet = workbook[workbook.sheetnames[sheet] if isinstance(sheet, int) else sheet]
    worksheet.reset_dimensions()
    raw_rows = list(worksheet.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    workbook.close()
    header_index = None
    best_nonblank = -1
    for index, row in enumerate(raw_rows[:20]):
        nonblank = sum(value is not None for value in row)
        if nonblank > best_nonblank:
            best_nonblank = nonblank
            header_index = index
    if header_index is None:
        return 0, [], []
    headers = [clean_text(value) for value in raw_rows[header_index]]
    records = []
    for row in raw_rows[header_index + 1 :]:
        if not any(value is not None for value in row):
            continue
        records.append(dict(zip(headers, row)))
    return header_index + 1, headers, records

    funding_allocation_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    funding_by_cycle: dict[str, Decimal] = collections.defaultdict(Decimal)
    funding_events_by_cycle: dict[str, list[str]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    funding_candidate_by_source = {
        str(row["funding_event_record_id"]): row for row in funding_candidates
    }
    for candidate in funding_candidates:
        source_id = str(candidate["funding_event_record_id"])
        candidates = pipe_ids(candidate.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
        b01_raw = future_source_to_b01.get(source_id)
        if len(candidates) == 1:
            assigned_cycle = candidates[0]
            attribution = "UNIQUE_OPEN_CYCLE_AT_SETTLEMENT"
            confidence = "高"
            evidence_level = "F3"
        elif len(candidates) == 2:
            matching = [
                cycle_id
                for cycle_id in candidates
                if cycle_origin.get(cycle_id)
                == ("COPY_TRADING" if b01_raw else "PERSONAL_ACTIVE")
            ]
            if len(matching) != 1:
                raise RuntimeError(f"资金费账户范围消歧失败：{source_id}")
            assigned_cycle = matching[0]
            attribution = (
                "B01_DIRECT_COPY_EVENT"
                if b01_raw
                else "B01_IDENTIFIED_COPY_COUNTERPART_LEAVES_NORMAL_ACCOUNT_EVENT"
            )
            confidence = "高"
            evidence_level = "F2+F3" if b01_raw else "F3"
        else:
            raise RuntimeError(f"资金费候选数异常：{source_id} {len(candidates)}")
        amount = decimal_value(candidate.get("amount")) or ZERO
        funding_by_cycle[assigned_cycle] += amount
        funding_events_by_cycle[assigned_cycle].append(source_id)
        funding_allocation_rows.append(
            {
                **candidate,
                "assigned_position_cycle_id": assigned_cycle,
                "assigned_T_or_U": (
                    cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("manual_review_trade_ids")
                    or cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("u_number")
                ),
                "trading_origin": cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("trading_origin"),
                "ordinary_or_copy_attribution": (
                    "COPY" if b01_raw else "NORMAL_FUTURES"
                ),
                "B01_standard_record_id": (
                    b01_raw.get("standard_record_id") if b01_raw else None
                ),
                "stage07_attribution_basis": attribution,
                "stage07_attribution_confidence": confidence,
                "stage07_evidence_level": evidence_level,
                "stage07_allocation_status": "ALLOCATED_WITH_ACCOUNT_SCOPE_EVIDENCE",
                "double_count_prevention": (
                    "B01与普通合约同一资金费只计普通合约canonical一次"
                    if b01_raw
                    else "普通合约canonical只计一次"
                ),
            }
        )
        future_row = unified_by_source[source_id]
        future_row["candidate_position_cycle_ids"] = "|".join(candidates)
        future_row["cycle_allocation_status"] = (
            "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CYCLE_FUNDING"
        )
        future_row["account_scope"] = (
            "COPY_TRADING_PORTFOLIO"
            if cycle_origin.get(assigned_cycle) == "COPY_TRADING"
            else "UM_FUTURES_ACCOUNT"
        )

    if len(funding_allocation_rows) != 54:
        raise RuntimeError("54笔资金费未全部完成阶段07账户范围消歧")

    # 手续费返还只形成周期候选，不因缺少直接业务ID而强制计入周期现金结果。
    rebate_by_cycle: dict[str, Decimal] = collections.defaultdict(Decimal)
    rebate_count_by_cycle: dict[str, int] = collections.defaultdict(int)
    for row in unified:
        if (
            row["source_dataset"] == "FUTURES_LEDGER"
            and row["source_business_type_standard"] == "COMMISSION_REBATE"
        ):
            candidates = pipe_ids(row.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
            if len(candidates) == 1:
                rebate_by_cycle[candidates[0]] += (
                    decimal_value(row["amount_signed_exact"]) or ZERO
                )
                rebate_count_by_cycle[candidates[0]] += 1
                row["cycle_allocation_status"] = "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CANDIDATE_NOT_DIRECT"

def add_dataset(
        key: str,
        title: str,
        relative_output: str,
        rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
        notes: str,
        warnings: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        columns = column_defs(rows)
        data_path = WORK_DIR / f"{key}.jsonl"
        write_jsonl(data_path, rows)
        manifest["datasets"].append(
            {
                "key": key,
                "title": title,
                "notes": notes,
                "output_path": str(STAGE_DIR / relative_output),
                "data_jsonl": str(data_path),
                "expected_record_count": len(rows),
                "data_columns": columns,
                "field_description_rows": field_rows(columns),
                "warnings": warnings or [{"状态": "无新增阻断异常"}],
                "reconciliation": [
                    {
                        "check_item": "记录数量",
                        "source_count": len(rows),
                        "output_count": len(rows),
                        "difference": 0,
                        "status": "PASS",
                    }
                ],
                "source_info": [
                    {
                        "stage": "阶段07",
                        "input_scope": "阶段04—06正式输入/B01/原始截图只读",
                        "output_scope": relative_output,
                        "build_script": str(SCRIPT.relative_to(ROOT)),
                        "xlsx_authoring_engine": "@oai/artifact-tool",
                        "phase08_executed": "否",
                    }
                ],
            }
        )

            "品种": str(row05["symbol"]),

            "周期已实现盈亏": float(net_result),
            "A136映射等级": a136_level,
            "A136用户确认状态": confirmation,
            "新增5笔记录性质": record_nature.get(str(new_t)),
            "后续个人行为分析资格": "是" if is_active else "否",
            "后续资金轨迹资格": "是",
            "证据来源文件": evidence_files,
            "证据来源工作表": evidence_sheets,

            "后续个人行为分析资格": "是" if is_active else "否",

            "证据来源文件": evidence_files,
            "证据来源工作表": evidence_sheets,
            "证据定位": f"position_cycle_id={cycle_id}；旧技术展示编号={old_display}",

            "后续个人行为分析资格": "是" if is_active else "否",

            "证据来源文件": evidence_files,
            "证据来源工作表": evidence_sheets,

source_locators.text:
for row05 in stage05:
        cycle_id = str(row05["position_cycle_id"])
        row06 = by06[cycle_id]
        old_display = old_display_by_cycle[cycle_id]
        new_t = new_by_cycle[cycle_id]
        is_active = cycle_id in active_cycles
        old_t = old_display if old_display.startswith("T") else None
        if old_t:
            a136_level = str(a136_old_map[old_t]["映射等级"])
            confirmation = "用户已确认修订正确" if a136_level == "STRONG" else "用户已确认"
            number_source = "阶段06旧T＋A136旧131映射"
            a136_file = source_paths["a136_03"]
            a136_sheet = "131笔映射候选"
        elif new_t:
            a136_level = "STRONG"
            confirmation = "用户已确认"
            number_source = "阶段06旧U＋A136新增5笔映射"
            a136_file = source_paths["a136_04"]
            a136_sheet = "U周期匹配候选"
        else:
            a136_level = None
            confirmation = "不适用（自动跟单隔离）"
            number_source = "阶段06旧U＋自动跟单隔离"
            a136_file = source_paths["a136_07"]
            a136_sheet = "用户确认清单"
        net_result = d(byp3[cycle_id]["周期净结果"])
        evidence_files = "；".join([
            source_paths["stage05_cycles"], source_paths["stage06_coverage"],
            source_paths["stage09_coverage"], source_paths["p3"], a136_file,
        ])
        evidence_sheets = "重建数据；周期覆盖；148周期明细；_仓位主数据；" + a136_sheet
        note_parts: list[str] = []
        if new_t in record_nature:
            note_parts.append("记录性质为用户确认的人工记录性质，不是交易所客观事实")
        if not is_active:
            note_parts.append("仅进入资金轨迹和资金节点；不得进入个人交易行为、心理、策略、纪律和交易系统分析")
        core_rows.append({
            "mapping_version": mapping_version,
            "position_cycle_id": cycle_id,
            "旧技术展示编号": old_display,
            "旧人工复盘编号": old_t,
            "新人工复盘编号": new_t,
            "编号来源": number_source,
            "交易来源分类": "个人主动" if is_active else "自动跟单",
            "是否个人主动": "是" if is_active else "否",
            "是否自动跟单": "否" if is_active else "是",
            "新编号状态": "已正式冻结" if new_t else "空值（永久不分配）",
            "旧编号保留状态": "永久保留",
            "品种": str(row05["symbol"]),
            "方向": direction_cn(row05["initial_direction"]),
            "正式首开Fill时间": trim_bjt(row05["cycle_start_time_beijing"]),
            "正式最终归零Fill时间": trim_bjt(row05["cycle_end_time_beijing"]),
            "周期已实现盈亏": float(net_result),
            "A136映射等级": a136_level,
            "A136用户确认状态": confirmation,
            "新增5笔记录性质": record_nature.get(str(new_t)),
            "后续个人行为分析资格": "是" if is_active else "否",
            "后续资金轨迹资格": "是",
            "证据来源文件": evidence_files,
            "证据来源工作表": evidence_sheets,
            "证据定位": f"position_cycle_id={cycle_id}；旧技术展示编号={old_display}",
            "备注": "；".join(note_parts) if note_parts else None,

            "品种": str(row05["symbol"]),

            "正式最终归零Fill时间": trim_bjt(row05["cycle_end_time_beijing"]),
            "周期已实现盈亏": float(net_result),
            "A136映射等级": a136_level,
            "A136用户确认状态": confirmation,
            "新增5笔记录性质": record_nature.get(str(new_t)),
            "后续个人行为分析资格": "是" if is_active else "否",
            "后续资金轨迹资格": "是",
            "证据来源文件": evidence_files,
            "证据来源工作表": evidence_sheets,
            "证据定位": f"position_cycle_id={cycle_id}；旧技术展示编号={old_display}",

def match_row(mapping: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "mapping_version": mapping["mapping_version"],
        "position_cycle_id": mapping["position_cycle_id"],
        "旧技术展示编号": mapping["旧技术展示编号"],
        "旧人工复盘编号": mapping.get("旧人工复盘编号"),
        "新人工复盘编号": mapping.get("新人工复盘编号"),
        "交易来源分类": mapping["交易来源分类"],
        "个人行为分析资格": mapping["后续个人行为分析资格"],
        "资金轨迹资格": mapping["后续资金轨迹资格"],
    }

def add_mapping(df: pd.DataFrame, source_col: str, lookup: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    keys = out[source_col].fillna("").astype(str)
    mapped = pd.DataFrame([match_row(lookup[k]) if k in lookup else {f: None for f in GLOBAL_FIELDS} for k in keys])
    for field in GLOBAL_FIELDS:
        out[field] = mapped[field]
    return out

def match_row(mapping: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "mapping_version": mapping["mapping_version"],
        "position_cycle_id": mapping["position_cycle_id"],
        "旧技术展示编号": mapping["旧技术展示编号"],
        "旧人工复盘编号": mapping.get("旧人工复盘编号"),
        "新人工复盘编号": mapping.get("新人工复盘编号"),
        "交易来源分类": mapping["交易来源分类"],
        "个人行为分析资格": mapping["后续个人行为分析资格"],
        "资金轨迹资格": mapping["后续资金轨迹资格"],
    }

def add_mapping(df: pd.DataFrame, source_col: str, lookup: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    keys = out[source_col].fillna("").astype(str)
    mapped = pd.DataFrame([match_row(lookup[k]) if k in lookup else {f: None for f in GLOBAL_FIELDS} for k in keys])
    for field in GLOBAL_FIELDS:
        out[field] = mapped[field]
    return out

def match_row(mapping: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "mapping_version": mapping["mapping_version"],
        "position_cycle_id": mapping["position_cycle_id"],
        "旧技术展示编号": mapping["旧技术展示编号"],
        "旧人工复盘编号": mapping.get("旧人工复盘编号"),
        "新人工复盘编号": mapping.get("新人工复盘编号"),
        "交易来源分类": mapping["交易来源分类"],
        "个人行为分析资格": mapping["后续个人行为分析资格"],
        "资金轨迹资格": mapping["后续资金轨迹资格"],
    }

def add_mapping(df: pd.DataFrame, source_col: str, lookup: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    keys = out[source_col].fillna("").astype(str)
    mapped = pd.DataFrame([match_row(lookup[k]) if k in lookup else {f: None for f in GLOBAL_FIELDS} for k in keys])
    for field in GLOBAL_FIELDS:
        out[field] = mapped[field]
    return out

def match_row(mapping: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "mapping_version": mapping["mapping_version"],
        "position_cycle_id": mapping["position_cycle_id"],
        "旧技术展示编号": mapping["旧技术展示编号"],

        "新人工复盘编号": mapping.get("新人工复盘编号"),
        "交易来源分类": mapping["交易来源分类"],
        "个人行为分析资格": mapping["后续个人行为分析资格"],
        "资金轨迹资格": mapping["后续资金轨迹资格"],
    }

def add_mapping(df: pd.DataFrame, source_col: str, lookup: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    keys = out[source_col].fillna("").astype(str)
    mapped = pd.DataFrame([match_row(lookup[k]) if k in lookup else {f: None for f in GLOBAL_FIELDS} for k in keys])
    for field in GLOBAL_FIELDS:
        out[field] = mapped[field]
    return out

def match_row(mapping: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "mapping_version": mapping["mapping_version"],
        "position_cycle_id": mapping["position_cycle_id"],
        "旧技术展示编号": mapping["旧技术展示编号"],
        "旧人工复盘编号": mapping.get("旧人工复盘编号"),
        "新人工复盘编号": mapping.get("新人工复盘编号"),
        "交易来源分类": mapping["交易来源分类"],
        "个人行为分析资格": mapping["后续个人行为分析资格"],
        "资金轨迹资格": mapping["后续资金轨迹资格"],
    }

def add_mapping(df: pd.DataFrame, source_col: str, lookup: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    keys = out[source_col].fillna("").astype(str)
    mapped = pd.DataFrame([match_row(lookup[k]) if k in lookup else {f: None for f in GLOBAL_FIELDS} for k in keys])
    for field in GLOBAL_FIELDS:
        out[field] = mapped[field]
    return out

    }

def add_mapping(df: pd.DataFrame, source_col: str, lookup: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    keys = out[source_col].fillna("").astype(str)
    mapped = pd.DataFrame([match_row(lookup[k]) if k in lookup else {f: None for f in GLOBAL_FIELDS} for k in keys])
    for field in GLOBAL_FIELDS:
        out[field] = mapped[field]
    return out

def match_row(mapping: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "mapping_version": mapping["mapping_version"],
        "position_cycle_id": mapping["position_cycle_id"],
        "旧技术展示编号": mapping["旧技术展示编号"],
        "旧人工复盘编号": mapping.get("旧人工复盘编号"),
        "新人工复盘编号": mapping.get("新人工复盘编号"),
        "交易来源分类": mapping["交易来源分类"],
        "个人行为分析资格": mapping["后续个人行为分析资格"],
        "资金轨迹资格": mapping["后续资金轨迹资格"],
    }

def add_mapping(df: pd.DataFrame, source_col: str, lookup: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    keys = out[source_col].fillna("").astype(str)
    mapped = pd.DataFrame([match_row(lookup[k]) if k in lookup else {f: None for f in GLOBAL_FIELDS} for k in keys])
    for field in GLOBAL_FIELDS:
        out[field] = mapped[field]
    return out

def match_row(mapping: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:

        "个人行为分析资格": mapping["后续个人行为分析资格"],
        "资金轨迹资格": mapping["后续资金轨迹资格"],
    }

def add_mapping(df: pd.DataFrame, source_col: str, lookup: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    keys = out[source_col].fillna("").astype(str)
    mapped = pd.DataFrame([match_row(lookup[k]) if k in lookup else {f: None for f in GLOBAL_FIELDS} for k in keys])
    for field in GLOBAL_FIELDS:
        out[field] = mapped[field]
    return out

def match_row(mapping: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "mapping_version": mapping["mapping_version"],
        "position_cycle_id": mapping["position_cycle_id"],
        "旧技术展示编号": mapping["旧技术展示编号"],
        "旧人工复盘编号": mapping.get("旧人工复盘编号"),
        "新人工复盘编号": mapping.get("新人工复盘编号"),
        "交易来源分类": mapping["交易来源分类"],
        "个人行为分析资格": mapping["后续个人行为分析资格"],
        "资金轨迹资格": mapping["后续资金轨迹资格"],
    }

def add_mapping(df: pd.DataFrame, source_col: str, lookup: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    keys = out[source_col].fillna("").astype(str)
    mapped = pd.DataFrame([match_row(lookup[k]) if k in lookup else {f: None for f in GLOBAL_FIELDS} for k in keys])
    for field in GLOBAL_FIELDS:
        out[field] = mapped[field]
    return out

def match_row(mapping: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "mapping_version": mapping["mapping_version"],
        "position_cycle_id": mapping["position_cycle_id"],
        "旧技术展示编号": mapping["旧技术展示编号"],
        "旧人工复盘编号": mapping.get("旧人工复盘编号"),
        "新人工复盘编号": mapping.get("新人工复盘编号"),
        "交易来源分类": mapping["交易来源分类"],
        "个人行为分析资格": mapping["后续个人行为分析资格"],
        "资金轨迹资格": mapping["后续资金轨迹资格"],
    }

def add_mapping(df: pd.DataFrame, source_col: str, lookup: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    keys = out[source_col].fillna("").astype(str)
    mapped = pd.DataFrame([match_row(lookup[k]) if k in lookup else {f: None for f in GLOBAL_FIELDS} for k in keys])
    for field in GLOBAL_FIELDS:
        out[field] = mapped[field]
    return out

def match_row(mapping: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "mapping_version": mapping["mapping_version"],
        "position_cycle_id": mapping["position_cycle_id"],
        "旧技术展示编号": mapping["旧技术展示编号"],
        "旧人工复盘编号": mapping.get("旧人工复盘编号"),
        "新人工复盘编号": mapping.get("新人工复盘编号"),
        "交易来源分类": mapping["交易来源分类"],
        "个人行为分析资格": mapping["后续个人行为分析资格"],
        "资金轨迹资格": mapping["后续资金轨迹资格"],
    }

def add_mapping(df: pd.DataFrame, source_col: str, lookup: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    keys = out[source_col].fillna("").astype(str)
    mapped = pd.DataFrame([match_row(lookup[k]) if k in lookup else {f: None for f in GLOBAL_FIELDS} for k in keys])
    for field in GLOBAL_FIELDS:
        out[field] = mapped[field]
    return out

def match_row(mapping: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "mapping_version": mapping["mapping_version"],
        "position_cycle_id": mapping["position_cycle_id"],
        "旧技术展示编号": mapping["旧技术展示编号"],
        "旧人工复盘编号": mapping.get("旧人工复盘编号"),
        "新人工复盘编号": mapping.get("新人工复盘编号"),
        "交易来源分类": mapping["交易来源分类"],
        "个人行为分析资格": mapping["后续个人行为分析资格"],
        "资金轨迹资格": mapping["后续资金轨迹资格"],
    }

def add_mapping(df: pd.DataFrame, source_col: str, lookup: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    keys = out[source_col].fillna("").astype(str)
    mapped = pd.DataFrame([match_row(lookup[k]) if k in lookup else {f: None for f in GLOBAL_FIELDS} for k in keys])
    for field in GLOBAL_FIELDS:
        out[field] = mapped[field]
    return out

def match_row(mapping: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "mapping_version": mapping["mapping_version"],
        "position_cycle_id": mapping["position_cycle_id"],
        "旧技术展示编号": mapping["旧技术展示编号"],
        "旧人工复盘编号": mapping.get("旧人工复盘编号"),
        "新人工复盘编号": mapping.get("新人工复盘编号"),
        "交易来源分类": mapping["交易来源分类"],
        "个人行为分析资格": mapping["后续个人行为分析资格"],
        "资金轨迹资格": mapping["后续资金轨迹资格"],
    }

def add_mapping(df: pd.DataFrame, source_col: str, lookup: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    keys = out[source_col].fillna("").astype(str)
    mapped = pd.DataFrame([match_row(lookup[k]) if k in lookup else {f: None for f in GLOBAL_FIELDS} for k in keys])
    for field in GLOBAL_FIELDS:
        out[field] = mapped[field]
    return out

def match_row(mapping: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "mapping_version": mapping["mapping_version"],
        "position_cycle_id": mapping["position_cycle_id"],
        "旧技术展示编号": mapping["旧技术展示编号"],
        "旧人工复盘编号": mapping.get("旧人工复盘编号"),
        "新人工复盘编号": mapping.get("新人工复盘编号"),
        "交易来源分类": mapping["交易来源分类"],
        "个人行为分析资格": mapping["后续个人行为分析资格"],
        "资金轨迹资格": mapping["后续资金轨迹资格"],
    }

def add_mapping(df: pd.DataFrame, source_col: str, lookup: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    keys = out[source_col].fillna("").astype(str)
    mapped = pd.DataFrame([match_row(lookup[k]) if k in lookup else {f: None for f in GLOBAL_FIELDS} for k in keys])
    for field in GLOBAL_FIELDS:
        out[field] = mapped[field]
    return out

def match_row(mapping: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {

        "position_cycle_id": mapping["position_cycle_id"],
        "旧技术展示编号": mapping["旧技术展示编号"],

        "交易来源分类": mapping["交易来源分类"],
        "个人行为分析资格": mapping["后续个人行为分析资格"],
        "资金轨迹资格": mapping["后续资金轨迹资格"],
    }

def add_mapping(df: pd.DataFrame, source_col: str, lookup: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    keys = out[source_col].fillna("").astype(str)
    mapped = pd.DataFrame([match_row(lookup[k]) if k in lookup else {f: None for f in GLOBAL_FIELDS} for k in keys])
    for field in GLOBAL_FIELDS:
        out[field] = mapped[field]
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def build_summary_models(position_rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    summaries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for row in position_rows:
        direction = text(row.get("position_side_standard_code"))
        require(direction in {"LONG", "SHORT"}, f"仓位摘要方向异常：{direction}")
        open_time = parse_time(row.get("open_time_utc"))
        close_time = parse_time(row.get("close_time_utc"))
        require(open_time is not None and close_time is not None, "仓位摘要时间为空")
        require(open_time <= close_time, "仓位摘要结束早于开始")
        summaries.append(
            {
                "summary_id": text(row.get("position_record_id"))
                or text(row.get("standard_record_id")),
                "source_record_id": text(row.get("standard_record_id")),
                "source_row_number": int(text(row.get("source_row_number")) or 0),
                "symbol": text(row.get("symbol_standard")),
                "direction": direction,
                "open_time": open_time,
                "close_time": close_time,
                "entry_price": decimal_value(row.get("entry_price"), allow_none=False),
                "entry_price_raw": text(row.get("entry_price")),
                "exit_price": decimal_value(row.get("exit_price"), allow_none=False),
                "exit_price_raw": text(row.get("exit_price")),
                "maximum_quantity": decimal_value(
                    row.get("maximum_position_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "maximum_quantity_raw": text(row.get("maximum_position_quantity")),
                "closed_quantity": decimal_value(
                    row.get("closed_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "closed_quantity_raw": text(row.get("closed_quantity")),
                "realized_pnl": decimal_value(row.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False),
                "realized_pnl_raw": text(row.get("realized_pnl")),
                "margin_mode": text(row.get("margin_mode_standard_code")),
                "position_status": text(row.get("position_status_standard_code")),
                "leverage": text(row.get("leverage")),
                "row": row,
                "assignments": [],
                "removed_order_ids": [],
            }
        )
    summaries.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            item["symbol"],
            item["open_time"],
            item["direction"],
            item["source_row_number"],
        )
    )
    return summaries

                summary["symbol"],
                "HEDGE",
                summary["direction"],

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))

                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,

                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

    components: Sequence[tuple[str, list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]],

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out
