def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }

def build_cycle_record(
    *,
    cycle_id: str,
    account_scope: str,
    symbol: str,
    position_mode: str,
    position_side: str,
    initial_direction: str,
    segments: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    fills_by_id: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],
    completion_status: str,
    boundary_confidence: str,
    evidence_level: str,
    summary_id: str | None,
    summary_validation_status: str | None,
    warning_codes: Sequence[str] = (),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ordered = sorted(
        segments,
        key=lambda segment: (
            parse_time(segment.get("event_time_utc")),
            int(segment.get("segment_sequence") or 0),
            numeric_sort_key(segment.get("trade_id")),
        ),
    )
    opening_roles = {
        "OPEN_INITIAL",
        "OPEN_REVERSE",
        "ADD_POSITION",
        "ZERO_CROSS_OPEN_SEGMENT",
    }
    closing_roles = {
        "REDUCE_POSITION",
        "CLOSE_PARTIAL",
        "CLOSE_FULL",
        "ZERO_CROSS_CLOSE_SEGMENT",
    }
    opening = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in opening_roles]
    closing = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in closing_roles]
    fill_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["fill_record_id"] for segment in ordered))
    order_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["order_id"] for segment in ordered))
    source_fills = [fills_by_id[fill_id] for fill_id in fill_ids]
    commission = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("commission"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    pnl = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    maximum_position = max(
        (
            abs(decimal_value(segment.get("position_after"), allow_none=False))
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        default=Decimal(0),
    )
    opening_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in opening
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    closing_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in closing
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    start = parse_time(ordered[0]["event_time_utc"])
    end = parse_time(ordered[-1]["event_time_utc"])
    warnings = list(dict.fromkeys(warning_codes))

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

    components: Sequence[tuple[str, list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]],

    scope_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for account_scope, component, metadata in components:
        by_symbol: collections.defaultdict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = (
            collections.defaultdict(list)
        )
        for fill in component:
            by_symbol[text(fill.get("symbol_standard")) or ""].append(fill)
        for symbol, symbol_fills in sorted(by_symbol.items()):
            partition_key = "|".join(
                [
                    account_scope,
                    symbol,
                    "UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                    "NET_CANDIDATE",
                ]
            )
            position = Decimal(0)
            active_cycle_id: str | None = None
            active_direction: str | None = None
            active_segments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            cycle_sequence = 0
            for fill in sorted(symbol_fills, key=source_sort_key):
                quantity = decimal_value(fill.get("fill_quantity"), allow_none=False)
                signed = quantity if text(fill.get("side_standard_code")) == "BUY" else -quantity
                before = position
                after = before + signed
                if before == 0:
                    cycle_sequence += 1
                    active_direction = "LONG" if after > 0 else "SHORT"
                    active_cycle_id = stable_id(
                        "S05-CYC",
                        account_scope,
                        symbol,
                        cycle_sequence,
                        text(fill.get("standard_record_id")),
                    )
                    active_segments = []
                require(active_cycle_id is not None, "剩余账户范围周期ID未建立")
                if before == 0 or before * after > 0 or after == 0:
                    if before == 0:
                        role = "OPEN_INITIAL"
                    elif after == 0:
                        role = "CLOSE_FULL"
                    elif abs(after) > abs(before):
                        role = "ADD_POSITION"
                    else:
                        role = "REDUCE_POSITION"
                    segment = make_segment(
                        fill=fill,
                        segment_sequence=1,
                        quantity=quantity,
                        signed_change=signed,
                        position_before=before,
                        position_after=after,
                        event_role=role,

                        position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                        cycle_id=active_cycle_id,
                        sequence_confidence="高",
                        evidence_level="E2",
                        assignment_basis=(

                        ),
                    )
                    segments.append(segment)
                    active_segments.append(segment)
                else:
                    close_quantity = abs(before)
                    open_quantity = abs(after)
                    close_signed = -before
                    close_segment = make_segment(
                        fill=fill,
                        segment_sequence=1,
                        quantity=close_quantity,
                        signed_change=close_signed,
                        position_before=before,
                        position_after=Decimal(0),
                        event_role="ZERO_CROSS_CLOSE_SEGMENT",
                        account_scope=account_scope,

                        position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                        cycle_id=active_cycle_id,
                        sequence_confidence="高",
                        evidence_level="E2",
                        assignment_basis="一条Fill穿越0；逻辑平仓片段",
                        zero_crossing=True,
                    )
                    segments.append(close_segment)
                    active_segments.append(close_segment)
                    cycles.append(
                        build_cycle_record(
                            cycle_id=active_cycle_id,

def build_cycle_record(
    *,
    cycle_id: str,
    account_scope: str,
    symbol: str,
    position_mode: str,
    position_side: str,
    initial_direction: str,
    segments: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    fills_by_id: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],
    completion_status: str,
    boundary_confidence: str,
    evidence_level: str,
    summary_id: str | None,
    summary_validation_status: str | None,
    warning_codes: Sequence[str] = (),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ordered = sorted(
        segments,
        key=lambda segment: (
            parse_time(segment.get("event_time_utc")),
            int(segment.get("segment_sequence") or 0),
            numeric_sort_key(segment.get("trade_id")),
        ),
    )
    opening_roles = {
        "OPEN_INITIAL",
        "OPEN_REVERSE",
        "ADD_POSITION",
        "ZERO_CROSS_OPEN_SEGMENT",
    }
    closing_roles = {
        "REDUCE_POSITION",
        "CLOSE_PARTIAL",
        "CLOSE_FULL",
        "ZERO_CROSS_CLOSE_SEGMENT",
    }
    opening = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in opening_roles]
    closing = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in closing_roles]
    fill_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["fill_record_id"] for segment in ordered))
    order_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["order_id"] for segment in ordered))
    source_fills = [fills_by_id[fill_id] for fill_id in fill_ids]
    commission = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("commission"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    pnl = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    maximum_position = max(
        (
            abs(decimal_value(segment.get("position_after"), allow_none=False))
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        default=Decimal(0),
    )
    opening_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in opening
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    closing_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in closing
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    start = parse_time(ordered[0]["event_time_utc"])
    end = parse_time(ordered[-1]["event_time_utc"])
    warnings = list(dict.fromkeys(warning_codes))
    return {
        "position_cycle_id": cycle_id,
        "account_scope": account_scope,
        "portfolio_id_or_scope_label": account_scope,
        "partition_key": ordered[0]["partition_key"],
        "symbol": symbol,
        "position_mode": position_mode,
        "position_side_or_net_direction": position_side,
        "initial_direction": initial_direction,
        "cycle_start_time_utc": time_text(start, "UTC"),
        "cycle_start_time_beijing": time_text(start, "BEIJING"),
        "cycle_end_time_utc": time_text(end, "UTC"),
        "cycle_end_time_beijing": time_text(end, "BEIJING"),
        "holding_duration": duration_text(start, end),
        "opening_fill_count": len(opening),
        "closing_fill_count": len(closing),
        "total_fill_count": len(fill_ids),
        "order_count": len(order_ids),
        "opening_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in opening}
        ),
        "closing_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in closing}
        ),
        "add_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "ADD_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reduce_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "REDUCE_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "partial_close_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] in {"REDUCE_POSITION", "CLOSE_PARTIAL"}
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reverse_event_count": sum(
            segment["zero_crossing_flag"] == "是" for segment in ordered
        )
        // 2,
        "maximum_absolute_position": decimal_text(maximum_position),
        "opening_quantity_total": decimal_text(opening_quantity),
        "closing_quantity_total": decimal_text(closing_quantity),
        "weighted_entry_price": decimal_text(weighted_price(opening)),
        "weighted_exit_price": decimal_text(weighted_price(closing)),
        "fill_realized_pnl_sum": decimal_text(pnl),
        "futures_ledger_realized_pnl_direct_sum": None,
        "canonical_realized_pnl": decimal_text(pnl),
        "realized_pnl_source": "Fill成交历史为权威口径；合约流水仅核对",
        "realized_pnl_reconciliation_difference": None,
        "realized_pnl_reconciliation_status": "待本阶段流水核对表逐Fill汇总",
        "direct_commission_sum": decimal_text(commission),
        "fill_commission_sum": decimal_text(commission),
        "futures_ledger_commission_direct_sum": None,
        "canonical_commission": decimal_text(commission),
        "commission_source": "Fill成交历史为权威口径；合约流水仅核对",
        "commission_reconciliation_difference": None,
        "commission_reconciliation_status": "待本阶段流水核对表逐Fill汇总",
        "cycle_completion_status": completion_status,
        "boundary_confidence": boundary_confidence,
        "evidence_level": evidence_level,
        "summary_record_id": summary_id,
        "summary_validation_status": summary_validation_status,
        "source_fill_ids": "|".join(fill_ids),
        "source_order_ids": "|".join(order_ids),
        "warning_count": len(warnings),
        "warning_codes": "|".join(warnings) if warnings else None,
        "phase06_candidate_eligibility": (
            "允许候选匹配"
            if completion_status == "COMPLETE"
            else "仅在证据充分时允许"
        ),
        "prohibited_phase05_actions": "未匹配T编号；未创建U编号；未分配资金费",
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def build_summary_models(position_rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    summaries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for row in position_rows:
        direction = text(row.get("position_side_standard_code"))
        require(direction in {"LONG", "SHORT"}, f"仓位摘要方向异常：{direction}")
        open_time = parse_time(row.get("open_time_utc"))
        close_time = parse_time(row.get("close_time_utc"))
        require(open_time is not None and close_time is not None, "仓位摘要时间为空")
        require(open_time <= close_time, "仓位摘要结束早于开始")
        summaries.append(
            {
                "summary_id": text(row.get("position_record_id"))
                or text(row.get("standard_record_id")),
                "source_record_id": text(row.get("standard_record_id")),
                "source_row_number": int(text(row.get("source_row_number")) or 0),
                "symbol": text(row.get("symbol_standard")),
                "direction": direction,
                "open_time": open_time,
                "close_time": close_time,
                "entry_price": decimal_value(row.get("entry_price"), allow_none=False),
                "entry_price_raw": text(row.get("entry_price")),
                "exit_price": decimal_value(row.get("exit_price"), allow_none=False),
                "exit_price_raw": text(row.get("exit_price")),
                "maximum_quantity": decimal_value(
                    row.get("maximum_position_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "maximum_quantity_raw": text(row.get("maximum_position_quantity")),
                "closed_quantity": decimal_value(
                    row.get("closed_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "closed_quantity_raw": text(row.get("closed_quantity")),
                "realized_pnl": decimal_value(row.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False),
                "realized_pnl_raw": text(row.get("realized_pnl")),
                "margin_mode": text(row.get("margin_mode_standard_code")),
                "position_status": text(row.get("position_status_standard_code")),
                "leverage": text(row.get("leverage")),
                "row": row,
                "assignments": [],
                "removed_order_ids": [],
            }
        )
    summaries.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            item["symbol"],
            item["open_time"],
            item["direction"],
            item["source_row_number"],
        )

def build_cycle_record(
    *,
    cycle_id: str,
    account_scope: str,
    symbol: str,
    position_mode: str,
    position_side: str,
    initial_direction: str,
    segments: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    fills_by_id: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],
    completion_status: str,
    boundary_confidence: str,
    evidence_level: str,
    summary_id: str | None,
    summary_validation_status: str | None,
    warning_codes: Sequence[str] = (),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ordered = sorted(
        segments,
        key=lambda segment: (
            parse_time(segment.get("event_time_utc")),
            int(segment.get("segment_sequence") or 0),
            numeric_sort_key(segment.get("trade_id")),
        ),
    )
    opening_roles = {
        "OPEN_INITIAL",
        "OPEN_REVERSE",
        "ADD_POSITION",
        "ZERO_CROSS_OPEN_SEGMENT",
    }
    closing_roles = {
        "REDUCE_POSITION",
        "CLOSE_PARTIAL",
        "CLOSE_FULL",
        "ZERO_CROSS_CLOSE_SEGMENT",
    }
    opening = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in opening_roles]
    closing = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in closing_roles]
    fill_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["fill_record_id"] for segment in ordered))
    order_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["order_id"] for segment in ordered))
    source_fills = [fills_by_id[fill_id] for fill_id in fill_ids]
    commission = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("commission"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    pnl = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    maximum_position = max(
        (
            abs(decimal_value(segment.get("position_after"), allow_none=False))
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        default=Decimal(0),
    )
    opening_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in opening
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    closing_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in closing
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    start = parse_time(ordered[0]["event_time_utc"])
    end = parse_time(ordered[-1]["event_time_utc"])
    warnings = list(dict.fromkeys(warning_codes))
    return {
        "position_cycle_id": cycle_id,
        "account_scope": account_scope,
        "portfolio_id_or_scope_label": account_scope,
        "partition_key": ordered[0]["partition_key"],
        "symbol": symbol,
        "position_mode": position_mode,
        "position_side_or_net_direction": position_side,
        "initial_direction": initial_direction,
        "cycle_start_time_utc": time_text(start, "UTC"),
        "cycle_start_time_beijing": time_text(start, "BEIJING"),
        "cycle_end_time_utc": time_text(end, "UTC"),
        "cycle_end_time_beijing": time_text(end, "BEIJING"),
        "holding_duration": duration_text(start, end),
        "opening_fill_count": len(opening),
        "closing_fill_count": len(closing),
        "total_fill_count": len(fill_ids),
        "order_count": len(order_ids),
        "opening_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in opening}
        ),
        "closing_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in closing}
        ),
        "add_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "ADD_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reduce_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "REDUCE_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "partial_close_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] in {"REDUCE_POSITION", "CLOSE_PARTIAL"}
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reverse_event_count": sum(
            segment["zero_crossing_flag"] == "是" for segment in ordered
        )
        // 2,
        "maximum_absolute_position": decimal_text(maximum_position),
        "opening_quantity_total": decimal_text(opening_quantity),
        "closing_quantity_total": decimal_text(closing_quantity),
        "weighted_entry_price": decimal_text(weighted_price(opening)),
        "weighted_exit_price": decimal_text(weighted_price(closing)),
        "fill_realized_pnl_sum": decimal_text(pnl),

def build_cycle_record(
    *,
    cycle_id: str,
    account_scope: str,
    symbol: str,
    position_mode: str,
    position_side: str,
    initial_direction: str,
    segments: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    fills_by_id: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],
    completion_status: str,
    boundary_confidence: str,
    evidence_level: str,
    summary_id: str | None,
    summary_validation_status: str | None,
    warning_codes: Sequence[str] = (),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ordered = sorted(
        segments,
        key=lambda segment: (
            parse_time(segment.get("event_time_utc")),
            int(segment.get("segment_sequence") or 0),
            numeric_sort_key(segment.get("trade_id")),
        ),
    )
    opening_roles = {
        "OPEN_INITIAL",
        "OPEN_REVERSE",
        "ADD_POSITION",
        "ZERO_CROSS_OPEN_SEGMENT",
    }
    closing_roles = {
        "REDUCE_POSITION",
        "CLOSE_PARTIAL",
        "CLOSE_FULL",
        "ZERO_CROSS_CLOSE_SEGMENT",
    }
    opening = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in opening_roles]
    closing = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in closing_roles]
    fill_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["fill_record_id"] for segment in ordered))
    order_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["order_id"] for segment in ordered))
    source_fills = [fills_by_id[fill_id] for fill_id in fill_ids]
    commission = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("commission"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    pnl = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    maximum_position = max(
        (
            abs(decimal_value(segment.get("position_after"), allow_none=False))
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        default=Decimal(0),
    )
    opening_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in opening
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    closing_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in closing
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    start = parse_time(ordered[0]["event_time_utc"])
    end = parse_time(ordered[-1]["event_time_utc"])
    warnings = list(dict.fromkeys(warning_codes))
    return {
        "position_cycle_id": cycle_id,
        "account_scope": account_scope,
        "portfolio_id_or_scope_label": account_scope,
        "partition_key": ordered[0]["partition_key"],
        "symbol": symbol,
        "position_mode": position_mode,
        "position_side_or_net_direction": position_side,
        "initial_direction": initial_direction,
        "cycle_start_time_utc": time_text(start, "UTC"),
        "cycle_start_time_beijing": time_text(start, "BEIJING"),
        "cycle_end_time_utc": time_text(end, "UTC"),
        "cycle_end_time_beijing": time_text(end, "BEIJING"),
        "holding_duration": duration_text(start, end),
        "opening_fill_count": len(opening),
        "closing_fill_count": len(closing),
        "total_fill_count": len(fill_ids),
        "order_count": len(order_ids),
        "opening_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in opening}
        ),
        "closing_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in closing}
        ),
        "add_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "ADD_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reduce_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "REDUCE_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "partial_close_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] in {"REDUCE_POSITION", "CLOSE_PARTIAL"}
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reverse_event_count": sum(
            segment["zero_crossing_flag"] == "是" for segment in ordered
        )
        // 2,
        "maximum_absolute_position": decimal_text(maximum_position),
        "opening_quantity_total": decimal_text(opening_quantity),
        "closing_quantity_total": decimal_text(closing_quantity),

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def build_cycle_record(
    *,
    cycle_id: str,
    account_scope: str,
    symbol: str,
    position_mode: str,
    position_side: str,
    initial_direction: str,
    segments: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    fills_by_id: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],
    completion_status: str,
    boundary_confidence: str,
    evidence_level: str,
    summary_id: str | None,
    summary_validation_status: str | None,
    warning_codes: Sequence[str] = (),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ordered = sorted(
        segments,
        key=lambda segment: (
            parse_time(segment.get("event_time_utc")),
            int(segment.get("segment_sequence") or 0),
            numeric_sort_key(segment.get("trade_id")),
        ),
    )
    opening_roles = {
        "OPEN_INITIAL",
        "OPEN_REVERSE",
        "ADD_POSITION",
        "ZERO_CROSS_OPEN_SEGMENT",
    }
    closing_roles = {
        "REDUCE_POSITION",
        "CLOSE_PARTIAL",
        "CLOSE_FULL",
        "ZERO_CROSS_CLOSE_SEGMENT",
    }
    opening = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in opening_roles]
    closing = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in closing_roles]
    fill_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["fill_record_id"] for segment in ordered))
    order_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["order_id"] for segment in ordered))
    source_fills = [fills_by_id[fill_id] for fill_id in fill_ids]
    commission = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("commission"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    pnl = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    maximum_position = max(
        (
            abs(decimal_value(segment.get("position_after"), allow_none=False))
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        default=Decimal(0),
    )
    opening_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in opening
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    closing_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in closing
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    start = parse_time(ordered[0]["event_time_utc"])
    end = parse_time(ordered[-1]["event_time_utc"])
    warnings = list(dict.fromkeys(warning_codes))
    return {
        "position_cycle_id": cycle_id,
        "account_scope": account_scope,
        "portfolio_id_or_scope_label": account_scope,
        "partition_key": ordered[0]["partition_key"],
        "symbol": symbol,
        "position_mode": position_mode,
        "position_side_or_net_direction": position_side,
        "initial_direction": initial_direction,
        "cycle_start_time_utc": time_text(start, "UTC"),
        "cycle_start_time_beijing": time_text(start, "BEIJING"),
        "cycle_end_time_utc": time_text(end, "UTC"),
        "cycle_end_time_beijing": time_text(end, "BEIJING"),
        "holding_duration": duration_text(start, end),
        "opening_fill_count": len(opening),
        "closing_fill_count": len(closing),
        "total_fill_count": len(fill_ids),
        "order_count": len(order_ids),
        "opening_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in opening}
        ),
        "closing_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in closing}
        ),
        "add_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "ADD_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reduce_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "REDUCE_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "partial_close_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] in {"REDUCE_POSITION", "CLOSE_PARTIAL"}
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reverse_event_count": sum(
            segment["zero_crossing_flag"] == "是" for segment in ordered
        )
        // 2,
        "maximum_absolute_position": decimal_text(maximum_position),
        "opening_quantity_total": decimal_text(opening_quantity),
        "closing_quantity_total": decimal_text(closing_quantity),
        "weighted_entry_price": decimal_text(weighted_price(opening)),
        "weighted_exit_price": decimal_text(weighted_price(closing)),
        "fill_realized_pnl_sum": decimal_text(pnl),
        "futures_ledger_realized_pnl_direct_sum": None,
        "canonical_realized_pnl": decimal_text(pnl),
        "realized_pnl_source": "Fill成交历史为权威口径；合约流水仅核对",
        "realized_pnl_reconciliation_difference": None,
        "realized_pnl_reconciliation_status": "待本阶段流水核对表逐Fill汇总",

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],

    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],

    out = []

        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,

        )
        out.append(tagged_row)

def build_cycle_record(
    *,
    cycle_id: str,
    account_scope: str,
    symbol: str,
    position_mode: str,
    position_side: str,
    initial_direction: str,
    segments: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    fills_by_id: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],
    completion_status: str,
    boundary_confidence: str,
    evidence_level: str,
    summary_id: str | None,
    summary_validation_status: str | None,
    warning_codes: Sequence[str] = (),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ordered = sorted(
        segments,
        key=lambda segment: (
            parse_time(segment.get("event_time_utc")),
            int(segment.get("segment_sequence") or 0),
            numeric_sort_key(segment.get("trade_id")),
        ),
    )
    opening_roles = {
        "OPEN_INITIAL",
        "OPEN_REVERSE",
        "ADD_POSITION",
        "ZERO_CROSS_OPEN_SEGMENT",
    }
    closing_roles = {
        "REDUCE_POSITION",
        "CLOSE_PARTIAL",
        "CLOSE_FULL",
        "ZERO_CROSS_CLOSE_SEGMENT",
    }
    opening = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in opening_roles]
    closing = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in closing_roles]
    fill_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["fill_record_id"] for segment in ordered))
    order_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["order_id"] for segment in ordered))
    source_fills = [fills_by_id[fill_id] for fill_id in fill_ids]
    commission = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("commission"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    pnl = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    maximum_position = max(
        (
            abs(decimal_value(segment.get("position_after"), allow_none=False))
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        default=Decimal(0),
    )
    opening_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in opening
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    closing_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in closing
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    start = parse_time(ordered[0]["event_time_utc"])
    end = parse_time(ordered[-1]["event_time_utc"])
    warnings = list(dict.fromkeys(warning_codes))
    return {
        "position_cycle_id": cycle_id,
        "account_scope": account_scope,
        "portfolio_id_or_scope_label": account_scope,
        "partition_key": ordered[0]["partition_key"],
        "symbol": symbol,
        "position_mode": position_mode,
        "position_side_or_net_direction": position_side,
        "initial_direction": initial_direction,
        "cycle_start_time_utc": time_text(start, "UTC"),
        "cycle_start_time_beijing": time_text(start, "BEIJING"),
        "cycle_end_time_utc": time_text(end, "UTC"),
        "cycle_end_time_beijing": time_text(end, "BEIJING"),
        "holding_duration": duration_text(start, end),
        "opening_fill_count": len(opening),
        "closing_fill_count": len(closing),
        "total_fill_count": len(fill_ids),
        "order_count": len(order_ids),
        "opening_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in opening}
        ),
        "closing_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in closing}
        ),
        "add_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "ADD_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reduce_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "REDUCE_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "partial_close_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] in {"REDUCE_POSITION", "CLOSE_PARTIAL"}
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reverse_event_count": sum(
            segment["zero_crossing_flag"] == "是" for segment in ordered
        )
        // 2,
        "maximum_absolute_position": decimal_text(maximum_position),
        "opening_quantity_total": decimal_text(opening_quantity),
        "closing_quantity_total": decimal_text(closing_quantity),
        "weighted_entry_price": decimal_text(weighted_price(opening)),
        "weighted_exit_price": decimal_text(weighted_price(closing)),
        "fill_realized_pnl_sum": decimal_text(pnl),
        "futures_ledger_realized_pnl_direct_sum": None,
        "canonical_realized_pnl": decimal_text(pnl),
        "realized_pnl_source": "Fill成交历史为权威口径；合约流水仅核对",
        "realized_pnl_reconciliation_difference": None,
        "realized_pnl_reconciliation_status": "待本阶段流水核对表逐Fill汇总",

    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],

    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,

                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)

def build_summary_models(position_rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    summaries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for row in position_rows:
        direction = text(row.get("position_side_standard_code"))
        require(direction in {"LONG", "SHORT"}, f"仓位摘要方向异常：{direction}")
        open_time = parse_time(row.get("open_time_utc"))
        close_time = parse_time(row.get("close_time_utc"))
        require(open_time is not None and close_time is not None, "仓位摘要时间为空")
        require(open_time <= close_time, "仓位摘要结束早于开始")
        summaries.append(
            {
                "summary_id": text(row.get("position_record_id"))
                or text(row.get("standard_record_id")),
                "source_record_id": text(row.get("standard_record_id")),
                "source_row_number": int(text(row.get("source_row_number")) or 0),
                "symbol": text(row.get("symbol_standard")),
                "direction": direction,
                "open_time": open_time,
                "close_time": close_time,
                "entry_price": decimal_value(row.get("entry_price"), allow_none=False),
                "entry_price_raw": text(row.get("entry_price")),
                "exit_price": decimal_value(row.get("exit_price"), allow_none=False),
                "exit_price_raw": text(row.get("exit_price")),
                "maximum_quantity": decimal_value(
                    row.get("maximum_position_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "maximum_quantity_raw": text(row.get("maximum_position_quantity")),
                "closed_quantity": decimal_value(
                    row.get("closed_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "closed_quantity_raw": text(row.get("closed_quantity")),
                "realized_pnl": decimal_value(row.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False),
                "realized_pnl_raw": text(row.get("realized_pnl")),
                "margin_mode": text(row.get("margin_mode_standard_code")),
                "position_status": text(row.get("position_status_standard_code")),
                "leverage": text(row.get("leverage")),
                "row": row,
                "assignments": [],
                "removed_order_ids": [],
            }
        )
    summaries.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            item["symbol"],
            item["open_time"],
            item["direction"],
            item["source_row_number"],
        )
    )
    return summaries

def build_cycle_record(
    *,
    cycle_id: str,
    account_scope: str,
    symbol: str,
    position_mode: str,
    position_side: str,
    initial_direction: str,
    segments: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    fills_by_id: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],
    completion_status: str,
    boundary_confidence: str,
    evidence_level: str,
    summary_id: str | None,
    summary_validation_status: str | None,
    warning_codes: Sequence[str] = (),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ordered = sorted(
        segments,
        key=lambda segment: (
            parse_time(segment.get("event_time_utc")),
            int(segment.get("segment_sequence") or 0),
            numeric_sort_key(segment.get("trade_id")),
        ),
    )
    opening_roles = {
        "OPEN_INITIAL",
        "OPEN_REVERSE",
        "ADD_POSITION",
        "ZERO_CROSS_OPEN_SEGMENT",
    }
    closing_roles = {
        "REDUCE_POSITION",
        "CLOSE_PARTIAL",
        "CLOSE_FULL",
        "ZERO_CROSS_CLOSE_SEGMENT",
    }
    opening = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in opening_roles]
    closing = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in closing_roles]
    fill_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["fill_record_id"] for segment in ordered))
    order_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["order_id"] for segment in ordered))
    source_fills = [fills_by_id[fill_id] for fill_id in fill_ids]
    commission = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("commission"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    pnl = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    maximum_position = max(
        (
            abs(decimal_value(segment.get("position_after"), allow_none=False))
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        default=Decimal(0),
    )
    opening_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in opening
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    closing_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in closing
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    start = parse_time(ordered[0]["event_time_utc"])
    end = parse_time(ordered[-1]["event_time_utc"])
    warnings = list(dict.fromkeys(warning_codes))
    return {
        "position_cycle_id": cycle_id,
        "account_scope": account_scope,
        "portfolio_id_or_scope_label": account_scope,
        "partition_key": ordered[0]["partition_key"],
        "symbol": symbol,
        "position_mode": position_mode,
        "position_side_or_net_direction": position_side,
        "initial_direction": initial_direction,
        "cycle_start_time_utc": time_text(start, "UTC"),
        "cycle_start_time_beijing": time_text(start, "BEIJING"),
        "cycle_end_time_utc": time_text(end, "UTC"),
        "cycle_end_time_beijing": time_text(end, "BEIJING"),
        "holding_duration": duration_text(start, end),
        "opening_fill_count": len(opening),
        "closing_fill_count": len(closing),
        "total_fill_count": len(fill_ids),
        "order_count": len(order_ids),
        "opening_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in opening}
        ),
        "closing_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in closing}
        ),
        "add_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "ADD_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reduce_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "REDUCE_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "partial_close_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] in {"REDUCE_POSITION", "CLOSE_PARTIAL"}
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reverse_event_count": sum(
            segment["zero_crossing_flag"] == "是" for segment in ordered
        )
        // 2,
        "maximum_absolute_position": decimal_text(maximum_position),
        "opening_quantity_total": decimal_text(opening_quantity),
        "closing_quantity_total": decimal_text(closing_quantity),
        "weighted_entry_price": decimal_text(weighted_price(opening)),
        "weighted_exit_price": decimal_text(weighted_price(closing)),
        "fill_realized_pnl_sum": decimal_text(pnl),
        "futures_ledger_realized_pnl_direct_sum": None,
        "canonical_realized_pnl": decimal_text(pnl),
        "realized_pnl_source": "Fill成交历史为权威口径；合约流水仅核对",
        "realized_pnl_reconciliation_difference": None,
        "realized_pnl_reconciliation_status": "待本阶段流水核对表逐Fill汇总",
        "direct_commission_sum": decimal_text(commission),
        "fill_commission_sum": decimal_text(commission),
        "futures_ledger_commission_direct_sum": None,
        "canonical_commission": decimal_text(commission),
        "commission_source": "Fill成交历史为权威口径；合约流水仅核对",
        "commission_reconciliation_difference": None,
        "commission_reconciliation_status": "待本阶段流水核对表逐Fill汇总",
        "cycle_completion_status": completion_status,
        "boundary_confidence": boundary_confidence,
        "evidence_level": evidence_level,
        "summary_record_id": summary_id,
        "summary_validation_status": summary_validation_status,
        "source_fill_ids": "|".join(fill_ids),
        "source_order_ids": "|".join(order_ids),
        "warning_count": len(warnings),
        "warning_codes": "|".join(warnings) if warnings else None,
        "phase06_candidate_eligibility": (

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

    residual_components = split_residual_scope_components(residual_fills)
    require(len(residual_components) == 2, "剩余Fill未形成2个自然账户范围候选")

    normal_segments, normal_cycles, summary_validations = (
        reconstruct_normal_cycles(summaries, fills_by_id)
    )
    residual_segments, residual_cycles, scope_rows = (
        reconstruct_residual_cycles(residual_components, fills_by_id)
    )
    segments = normal_segments + residual_segments
    cycles = sorted(
        normal_cycles + residual_cycles,
        key=lambda row: (
            parse_time(row["cycle_start_time_utc"]),
            row["account_scope"],
            row["symbol"],
            row["position_cycle_id"],
        ),
    )
    incomplete_segments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    require(len(normal_cycles) == 136, "普通摘要周期数不是136")
    require(len(residual_cycles) == 12, "隔离账户范围候选周期数不是12")
    require(len(cycles) == 148, "完整仓位周期数不是148")
    require(
        all(cycle["cycle_completion_status"] == "COMPLETE" for cycle in cycles),
        "存在非COMPLETE周期但未写入不完整区段",
    )

    (
        fill_enhanced,
        segments,
        position_events,
        position_ledger,
        same_second_rows,
    ) = build_fill_and_event_outputs(fills, segments, annotations)

    *,
    cycle_id: str,

    symbol: str,

    initial_direction: str,
    segments: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    fills_by_id: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],
    completion_status: str,
    boundary_confidence: str,
    evidence_level: str,
    summary_id: str | None,
    summary_validation_status: str | None,
    warning_codes: Sequence[str] = (),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ordered = sorted(
        segments,
        key=lambda segment: (
            parse_time(segment.get("event_time_utc")),
            int(segment.get("segment_sequence") or 0),
            numeric_sort_key(segment.get("trade_id")),
        ),
    )
    opening_roles = {
        "OPEN_INITIAL",
        "OPEN_REVERSE",
        "ADD_POSITION",
        "ZERO_CROSS_OPEN_SEGMENT",
    }
    closing_roles = {
        "REDUCE_POSITION",
        "CLOSE_PARTIAL",
        "CLOSE_FULL",
        "ZERO_CROSS_CLOSE_SEGMENT",
    }
    opening = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in opening_roles]
    closing = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in closing_roles]
    fill_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["fill_record_id"] for segment in ordered))
    order_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["order_id"] for segment in ordered))
    source_fills = [fills_by_id[fill_id] for fill_id in fill_ids]
    commission = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("commission"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    pnl = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    maximum_position = max(
        (
            abs(decimal_value(segment.get("position_after"), allow_none=False))
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        default=Decimal(0),
    )
    opening_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in opening
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    closing_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in closing
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    start = parse_time(ordered[0]["event_time_utc"])
    end = parse_time(ordered[-1]["event_time_utc"])
    warnings = list(dict.fromkeys(warning_codes))
    return {
        "position_cycle_id": cycle_id,
        "account_scope": account_scope,
        "portfolio_id_or_scope_label": account_scope,
        "partition_key": ordered[0]["partition_key"],
        "symbol": symbol,
        "position_mode": position_mode,
        "position_side_or_net_direction": position_side,
        "initial_direction": initial_direction,
        "cycle_start_time_utc": time_text(start, "UTC"),

        "holding_duration": duration_text(start, end),
        "opening_fill_count": len(opening),

        "total_fill_count": len(fill_ids),
        "order_count": len(order_ids),
        "opening_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in opening}
        ),
        "closing_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in closing}
        ),
        "add_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "ADD_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reduce_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "REDUCE_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "partial_close_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] in {"REDUCE_POSITION", "CLOSE_PARTIAL"}
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reverse_event_count": sum(

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

    components: Sequence[tuple[str, list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]],
    fills_by_id: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    segments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    cycles: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    scope_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for account_scope, component, metadata in components:
        by_symbol: collections.defaultdict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = (
            collections.defaultdict(list)
        )
        for fill in component:
            by_symbol[text(fill.get("symbol_standard")) or ""].append(fill)
        for symbol, symbol_fills in sorted(by_symbol.items()):
            partition_key = "|".join(
                [
                    account_scope,
                    symbol,
                    "UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                    "NET_CANDIDATE",
                ]
            )
            position = Decimal(0)
            active_cycle_id: str | None = None
            active_direction: str | None = None
            active_segments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            cycle_sequence = 0
            for fill in sorted(symbol_fills, key=source_sort_key):
                quantity = decimal_value(fill.get("fill_quantity"), allow_none=False)
                signed = quantity if text(fill.get("side_standard_code")) == "BUY" else -quantity
                before = position
                after = before + signed
                if before == 0:
                    cycle_sequence += 1
                    active_direction = "LONG" if after > 0 else "SHORT"
                    active_cycle_id = stable_id(
                        "S05-CYC",
                        account_scope,
                        symbol,
                        cycle_sequence,
                        text(fill.get("standard_record_id")),
                    )
                    active_segments = []
                require(active_cycle_id is not None, "剩余账户范围周期ID未建立")
                if before == 0 or before * after > 0 or after == 0:
                    if before == 0:
                        role = "OPEN_INITIAL"
                    elif after == 0:
                        role = "CLOSE_FULL"
                    elif abs(after) > abs(before):
                        role = "ADD_POSITION"
                    else:
                        role = "REDUCE_POSITION"
                    segment = make_segment(
                        fill=fill,
                        segment_sequence=1,
                        quantity=quantity,
                        signed_change=signed,
                        position_before=before,
                        position_after=after,
                        event_role=role,
                        account_scope=account_scope,
                        partition_key=partition_key,
                        position_mode="UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                        position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                        cycle_id=active_cycle_id,
                        sequence_confidence="高",
                        evidence_level="E2",
                        assignment_basis=(
                            "普通摘要外Fill独立数量路径；原始PositionSide缺失，"
                            "单向/单侧Hedge在本区段边界等价"
                        ),
                    )
                    segments.append(segment)
                    active_segments.append(segment)
                else:
                    close_quantity = abs(before)
                    open_quantity = abs(after)
                    close_signed = -before
                    close_segment = make_segment(
                        fill=fill,
                        segment_sequence=1,
                        quantity=close_quantity,
                        signed_change=close_signed,
                        position_before=before,
                        position_after=Decimal(0),
                        event_role="ZERO_CROSS_CLOSE_SEGMENT",
                        account_scope=account_scope,
                        partition_key=partition_key,
                        position_mode="UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                        position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                        cycle_id=active_cycle_id,
                        sequence_confidence="高",
                        evidence_level="E2",
                        assignment_basis="一条Fill穿越0；逻辑平仓片段",
                        zero_crossing=True,
                    )
                    segments.append(close_segment)
                    active_segments.append(close_segment)
                    cycles.append(
                        build_cycle_record(
                            cycle_id=active_cycle_id,
                            account_scope=account_scope,
                            symbol=symbol,
                            position_mode="UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                            position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                            initial_direction=active_direction or "UNRESOLVED",
                            segments=active_segments,
                            fills_by_id=fills_by_id,
                            completion_status="COMPLETE",
                            boundary_confidence="中高",
                            evidence_level="E2",
                            summary_id=None,
                            summary_validation_status="RECONSTRUCTION_ONLY",
                            warning_codes=["ACCOUNT_SCOPE_CANDIDATE"],
                        )
                    )
                    cycle_sequence += 1
                    active_direction = "LONG" if after > 0 else "SHORT"
                    active_cycle_id = stable_id(
                        "S05-CYC",
                        account_scope,
                        symbol,
                        cycle_sequence,
                        text(fill.get("standard_record_id")),
                        "REVERSE",
                    )
                    open_segment = make_segment(
                        fill=fill,
                        segment_sequence=2,
                        quantity=open_quantity,
                        signed_change=after,
                        position_before=Decimal(0),
                        position_after=after,
                        event_role="ZERO_CROSS_OPEN_SEGMENT",
                        account_scope=account_scope,
                        partition_key=partition_key,
                        position_mode="UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                        position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                        cycle_id=active_cycle_id,
                        sequence_confidence="高",
                        evidence_level="E2",
                        assignment_basis="一条Fill穿越0；逻辑反向开仓片段",
                        zero_crossing=True,
                    )
                    segments.append(open_segment)
                    active_segments = [open_segment]
                position = after
                if position == 0:
                    cycles.append(
                        build_cycle_record(
                            cycle_id=active_cycle_id,
                            account_scope=account_scope,
                            symbol=symbol,
                            position_mode="UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                            position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                            initial_direction=active_direction or "UNRESOLVED",
                            segments=active_segments,
                            fills_by_id=fills_by_id,
                            completion_status="COMPLETE",
                            boundary_confidence="中高",
                            evidence_level="E2",
                            summary_id=None,
                            summary_validation_status="RECONSTRUCTION_ONLY",
                            warning_codes=["ACCOUNT_SCOPE_CANDIDATE"],
                        )
                    )
                    active_cycle_id = None
                    active_direction = None
                    active_segments = []

def build_cycle_record(
    *,
    cycle_id: str,
    account_scope: str,
    symbol: str,
    position_mode: str,
    position_side: str,
    initial_direction: str,
    segments: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    fills_by_id: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],
    completion_status: str,
    boundary_confidence: str,
    evidence_level: str,
    summary_id: str | None,
    summary_validation_status: str | None,
    warning_codes: Sequence[str] = (),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ordered = sorted(
        segments,
        key=lambda segment: (
            parse_time(segment.get("event_time_utc")),
            int(segment.get("segment_sequence") or 0),
            numeric_sort_key(segment.get("trade_id")),
        ),
    )
    opening_roles = {
        "OPEN_INITIAL",
        "OPEN_REVERSE",
        "ADD_POSITION",
        "ZERO_CROSS_OPEN_SEGMENT",
    }
    closing_roles = {
        "REDUCE_POSITION",
        "CLOSE_PARTIAL",
        "CLOSE_FULL",
        "ZERO_CROSS_CLOSE_SEGMENT",
    }
    opening = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in opening_roles]
    closing = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in closing_roles]
    fill_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["fill_record_id"] for segment in ordered))
    order_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["order_id"] for segment in ordered))
    source_fills = [fills_by_id[fill_id] for fill_id in fill_ids]
    commission = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("commission"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    pnl = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    maximum_position = max(
        (
            abs(decimal_value(segment.get("position_after"), allow_none=False))
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        default=Decimal(0),
    )
    opening_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in opening
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    closing_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in closing
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    start = parse_time(ordered[0]["event_time_utc"])
    end = parse_time(ordered[-1]["event_time_utc"])
    warnings = list(dict.fromkeys(warning_codes))
    return {
        "position_cycle_id": cycle_id,
        "account_scope": account_scope,
        "portfolio_id_or_scope_label": account_scope,
        "partition_key": ordered[0]["partition_key"],
        "symbol": symbol,
        "position_mode": position_mode,
        "position_side_or_net_direction": position_side,
        "initial_direction": initial_direction,
        "cycle_start_time_utc": time_text(start, "UTC"),
        "cycle_start_time_beijing": time_text(start, "BEIJING"),
        "cycle_end_time_utc": time_text(end, "UTC"),
        "cycle_end_time_beijing": time_text(end, "BEIJING"),
        "holding_duration": duration_text(start, end),
        "opening_fill_count": len(opening),
        "closing_fill_count": len(closing),
        "total_fill_count": len(fill_ids),
        "order_count": len(order_ids),
        "opening_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in opening}
        ),
        "closing_order_count": len(
            {segment["order_id"] for segment in closing}
        ),
        "add_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "ADD_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reduce_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] == "REDUCE_POSITION" for segment in ordered
        ),
        "partial_close_count": sum(
            segment["segment_role"] in {"REDUCE_POSITION", "CLOSE_PARTIAL"}
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        "reverse_event_count": sum(
            segment["zero_crossing_flag"] == "是" for segment in ordered
        )
        // 2,
        "maximum_absolute_position": decimal_text(maximum_position),
        "opening_quantity_total": decimal_text(opening_quantity),
        "closing_quantity_total": decimal_text(closing_quantity),
        "weighted_entry_price": decimal_text(weighted_price(opening)),
        "weighted_exit_price": decimal_text(weighted_price(closing)),
        "fill_realized_pnl_sum": decimal_text(pnl),
        "futures_ledger_realized_pnl_direct_sum": None,
        "canonical_realized_pnl": decimal_text(pnl),
        "realized_pnl_source": "Fill成交历史为权威口径；合约流水仅核对",
        "realized_pnl_reconciliation_difference": None,
        "realized_pnl_reconciliation_status": "待本阶段流水核对表逐Fill汇总",
        "direct_commission_sum": decimal_text(commission),
        "fill_commission_sum": decimal_text(commission),
        "futures_ledger_commission_direct_sum": None,
        "canonical_commission": decimal_text(commission),
        "commission_source": "Fill成交历史为权威口径；合约流水仅核对",
        "commission_reconciliation_difference": None,
        "commission_reconciliation_status": "待本阶段流水核对表逐Fill汇总",
        "cycle_completion_status": completion_status,
        "boundary_confidence": boundary_confidence,
        "evidence_level": evidence_level,
        "summary_record_id": summary_id,
        "summary_validation_status": summary_validation_status,
        "source_fill_ids": "|".join(fill_ids),
        "source_order_ids": "|".join(order_ids),
        "warning_count": len(warnings),
        "warning_codes": "|".join(warnings) if warnings else None,
        "phase06_candidate_eligibility": (
            "允许候选匹配"
            if completion_status == "COMPLETE"

        ),
        "prohibited_phase05_actions": "未匹配T编号；未创建U编号；未分配资金费",
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def build_summary_models(position_rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    summaries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for row in position_rows:
        direction = text(row.get("position_side_standard_code"))
        require(direction in {"LONG", "SHORT"}, f"仓位摘要方向异常：{direction}")
        open_time = parse_time(row.get("open_time_utc"))
        close_time = parse_time(row.get("close_time_utc"))
        require(open_time is not None and close_time is not None, "仓位摘要时间为空")
        require(open_time <= close_time, "仓位摘要结束早于开始")
        summaries.append(
            {

                or text(row.get("standard_record_id")),
                "source_record_id": text(row.get("standard_record_id")),
                "source_row_number": int(text(row.get("source_row_number")) or 0),

                "exit_price_raw": text(row.get("exit_price")),
                "maximum_quantity": decimal_value(
                    row.get("maximum_position_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "maximum_quantity_raw": text(row.get("maximum_position_quantity")),
                "closed_quantity": decimal_value(
                    row.get("closed_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "closed_quantity_raw": text(row.get("closed_quantity")),
                "realized_pnl": decimal_value(row.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False),
                "realized_pnl_raw": text(row.get("realized_pnl")),
                "margin_mode": text(row.get("margin_mode_standard_code")),
