def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {

                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,

            }
        )

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))

def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:

    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),

def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

    primary_note: str,

    count_basis: str,
    fallback_columns: list[str] | None = None,

) -> dict[str, Any]:

                    "对账项目": count_basis,
                    "记录数": len(rows),
                    "结论": "PASS",

            "来源与边界",

            "阶段04人工复盘与阶段05_v2交易链均只读；人工值不覆盖币安事实。",
            source_info_rows([MANUAL_FILE, CYCLE_FILE, SOURCE_CLASS_FILE]),
        ),
    ]
    if extra_sheets:
        sheets.extend(extra_sheets)
    return {
        "key": key,
        "title": title,
        "output_path": str(output_path),
        "sheets": sheets,
    }

def workbook_item(
    key: str,
    title: str,
    output_path: Path,
    primary_name: str,
    primary_note: str,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    count_basis: str,
    fallback_columns: list[str] | None = None,
    extra_sheets: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    sheets = [
        make_sheet(
            primary_name,
            title,
            primary_note,
            rows,
            columns_from_rows(rows, fallback_columns),
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "数量对账",
            f"{title}｜数量对账",
            "阶段06覆盖控制；不得因匹配关系重复计算真实周期。",
            [
                {
                    "对账项目": count_basis,
                    "记录数": len(rows),
                    "结论": "PASS",
                    "阶段边界": "仅阶段06匹配，不执行阶段07",
                }
            ],
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "来源与边界",
            f"{title}｜来源与边界",
            "阶段04人工复盘与阶段05_v2交易链均只读；人工值不覆盖币安事实。",
            source_info_rows([MANUAL_FILE, CYCLE_FILE, SOURCE_CLASS_FILE]),
        ),
    ]
    if extra_sheets:
        sheets.extend(extra_sheets)
    return {
        "key": key,
        "title": title,
        "output_path": str(output_path),
        "sheets": sheets,
    }

def workbook_item(
    key: str,
    title: str,
    output_path: Path,
    primary_name: str,
    primary_note: str,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    count_basis: str,
    fallback_columns: list[str] | None = None,
    extra_sheets: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    sheets = [
        make_sheet(
            primary_name,
            title,
            primary_note,
            rows,
            columns_from_rows(rows, fallback_columns),

        make_sheet(
            "数量对账",
            f"{title}｜数量对账",
            "阶段06覆盖控制；不得因匹配关系重复计算真实周期。",

            "来源与边界",

            "阶段04人工复盘与阶段05_v2交易链均只读；人工值不覆盖币安事实。",
            source_info_rows([MANUAL_FILE, CYCLE_FILE, SOURCE_CLASS_FILE]),
        ),
    ]
    if extra_sheets:
        sheets.extend(extra_sheets)
    return {
        "key": key,
        "title": title,
        "output_path": str(output_path),
        "sheets": sheets,

def workbook_item(
    key: str,
    title: str,
    output_path: Path,
    primary_name: str,
    primary_note: str,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    count_basis: str,
    fallback_columns: list[str] | None = None,
    extra_sheets: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    sheets = [
        make_sheet(
            primary_name,
            title,
            primary_note,
            rows,
            columns_from_rows(rows, fallback_columns),
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "数量对账",
            f"{title}｜数量对账",
            "阶段06覆盖控制；不得因匹配关系重复计算真实周期。",
            [
                {
                    "对账项目": count_basis,
                    "记录数": len(rows),
                    "结论": "PASS",
                    "阶段边界": "仅阶段06匹配，不执行阶段07",
                }
            ],
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "来源与边界",
            f"{title}｜来源与边界",
            "阶段04人工复盘与阶段05_v2交易链均只读；人工值不覆盖币安事实。",
            source_info_rows([MANUAL_FILE, CYCLE_FILE, SOURCE_CLASS_FILE]),
        ),
    ]
    if extra_sheets:
        sheets.extend(extra_sheets)
    return {
        "key": key,
        "title": title,
        "output_path": str(output_path),
        "sheets": sheets,
    }

    key: str,
    title: str,
    output_path: Path,
    primary_name: str,
    primary_note: str,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    count_basis: str,
    fallback_columns: list[str] | None = None,
    extra_sheets: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    sheets = [
        make_sheet(
            primary_name,
            title,
            primary_note,
            rows,
            columns_from_rows(rows, fallback_columns),
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "数量对账",
            f"{title}｜数量对账",
            "阶段06覆盖控制；不得因匹配关系重复计算真实周期。",
            [
                {
                    "对账项目": count_basis,
                    "记录数": len(rows),
                    "结论": "PASS",
                    "阶段边界": "仅阶段06匹配，不执行阶段07",

            ],
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "来源与边界",
            f"{title}｜来源与边界",
            "阶段04人工复盘与阶段05_v2交易链均只读；人工值不覆盖币安事实。",
            source_info_rows([MANUAL_FILE, CYCLE_FILE, SOURCE_CLASS_FILE]),
        ),
    ]
    if extra_sheets:
        sheets.extend(extra_sheets)

        "key": key,
        "title": title,
        "output_path": str(output_path),
        "sheets": sheets,
    }

def workbook_item(
    key: str,
    title: str,
    output_path: Path,
    primary_name: str,
    primary_note: str,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    count_basis: str,
    fallback_columns: list[str] | None = None,
    extra_sheets: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    sheets = [
        make_sheet(
            primary_name,
            title,
            primary_note,
            rows,
            columns_from_rows(rows, fallback_columns),
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "数量对账",
            f"{title}｜数量对账",
            "阶段06覆盖控制；不得因匹配关系重复计算真实周期。",
            [
                {
                    "对账项目": count_basis,
                    "记录数": len(rows),
                    "结论": "PASS",
                    "阶段边界": "仅阶段06匹配，不执行阶段07",
                }
            ],
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "来源与边界",
            f"{title}｜来源与边界",
            "阶段04人工复盘与阶段05_v2交易链均只读；人工值不覆盖币安事实。",
            source_info_rows([MANUAL_FILE, CYCLE_FILE, SOURCE_CLASS_FILE]),
        ),
    ]
    if extra_sheets:
        sheets.extend(extra_sheets)
    return {
        "key": key,
        "title": title,
        "output_path": str(output_path),
        "sheets": sheets,
    }

def run_artifact_builder(expected_count: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    prepare_artifact_builder()
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.update(
        {
            "STAGE05_WORK_DIR": str(WORK),
            "STAGE05_MANIFEST_PATH": str(MANIFEST),
            "STAGE05_VALIDATION_PATH": str(VALIDATION),
            "STAGE05_EXPECTED_WORKBOOK_COUNT": str(expected_count),
        }
    )
    result = subprocess.run(
        [str(NODE), "--expose-gc", str(TEMP_BUILDER)],
        cwd=WORK,
        env=env,
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "artifact-tool构建失败\nSTDOUT:\n"
            f"{result.stdout}\nSTDERR:\n{result.stderr}"
        )
    validation = json.loads(VALIDATION.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if validation.get("status") != "passed":
        raise RuntimeError(f"artifact-tool验证未通过：{validation}")
    return {
        "stdout": result.stdout,
        "stderr": result.stderr,
        "validation": validation,

def workbook_item(
    key: str,
    title: str,
    output_path: Path,
    primary_name: str,
    primary_note: str,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    count_basis: str,
    fallback_columns: list[str] | None = None,
    extra_sheets: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    sheets = [
        make_sheet(
            primary_name,
            title,
            primary_note,
            rows,
            columns_from_rows(rows, fallback_columns),
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "数量对账",
            f"{title}｜数量对账",
            "阶段06覆盖控制；不得因匹配关系重复计算真实周期。",
            [
                {
                    "对账项目": count_basis,
                    "记录数": len(rows),
                    "结论": "PASS",
                    "阶段边界": "仅阶段06匹配，不执行阶段07",
                }
            ],
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "来源与边界",
            f"{title}｜来源与边界",
            "阶段04人工复盘与阶段05_v2交易链均只读；人工值不覆盖币安事实。",
            source_info_rows([MANUAL_FILE, CYCLE_FILE, SOURCE_CLASS_FILE]),
        ),
    ]
    if extra_sheets:
        sheets.extend(extra_sheets)
    return {
        "key": key,
        "title": title,
        "output_path": str(output_path),
        "sheets": sheets,
    }

    primary_note: str,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    count_basis: str,
    fallback_columns: list[str] | None = None,

) -> dict[str, Any]:

                    "记录数": len(rows),

            ],
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "来源与边界",
            f"{title}｜来源与边界",
            "阶段04人工复盘与阶段05_v2交易链均只读；人工值不覆盖币安事实。",
            source_info_rows([MANUAL_FILE, CYCLE_FILE, SOURCE_CLASS_FILE]),
        ),
    ]
    if extra_sheets:
        sheets.extend(extra_sheets)
    return {
        "key": key,
        "title": title,
        "output_path": str(output_path),
        "sheets": sheets,
    }

    key: str,
    title: str,
    output_path: Path,
    primary_name: str,
    primary_note: str,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    count_basis: str,
    fallback_columns: list[str] | None = None,
    extra_sheets: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    sheets = [
        make_sheet(
            primary_name,
            title,
            primary_note,
            rows,
            columns_from_rows(rows, fallback_columns),
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "数量对账",
            f"{title}｜数量对账",
            "阶段06覆盖控制；不得因匹配关系重复计算真实周期。",
            [
                {
                    "对账项目": count_basis,
                    "记录数": len(rows),
                    "结论": "PASS",
                    "阶段边界": "仅阶段06匹配，不执行阶段07",

            ],
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "来源与边界",
            f"{title}｜来源与边界",
            "阶段04人工复盘与阶段05_v2交易链均只读；人工值不覆盖币安事实。",
            source_info_rows([MANUAL_FILE, CYCLE_FILE, SOURCE_CLASS_FILE]),
        ),
    ]
    if extra_sheets:
        sheets.extend(extra_sheets)
    return {
        "key": key,
        "title": title,
        "output_path": str(output_path),
        "sheets": sheets,
    }

    key: str,
    title: str,
    output_path: Path,
    primary_name: str,
    primary_note: str,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    count_basis: str,
    fallback_columns: list[str] | None = None,
    extra_sheets: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    sheets = [
        make_sheet(
            primary_name,
            title,
            primary_note,
            rows,
            columns_from_rows(rows, fallback_columns),
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "数量对账",
            f"{title}｜数量对账",
            "阶段06覆盖控制；不得因匹配关系重复计算真实周期。",
            [
                {
                    "对账项目": count_basis,
                    "记录数": len(rows),
                    "结论": "PASS",
                    "阶段边界": "仅阶段06匹配，不执行阶段07",

            ],
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "来源与边界",

            "阶段04人工复盘与阶段05_v2交易链均只读；人工值不覆盖币安事实。",
            source_info_rows([MANUAL_FILE, CYCLE_FILE, SOURCE_CLASS_FILE]),
        ),
    ]
    if extra_sheets:

        "key": key,
        "title": title,

        "sheets": sheets,
    }

def workbook_item(
    key: str,
    title: str,
    output_path: Path,
    primary_name: str,
    primary_note: str,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    count_basis: str,
    fallback_columns: list[str] | None = None,
    extra_sheets: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    sheets = [
        make_sheet(
            primary_name,
            title,
            primary_note,
            rows,
            columns_from_rows(rows, fallback_columns),
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "数量对账",
            f"{title}｜数量对账",
            "阶段06覆盖控制；不得因匹配关系重复计算真实周期。",
            [
                {
                    "对账项目": count_basis,
                    "记录数": len(rows),
                    "结论": "PASS",
                    "阶段边界": "仅阶段06匹配，不执行阶段07",
                }
            ],
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "来源与边界",
            f"{title}｜来源与边界",
            "阶段04人工复盘与阶段05_v2交易链均只读；人工值不覆盖币安事实。",
            source_info_rows([MANUAL_FILE, CYCLE_FILE, SOURCE_CLASS_FILE]),
        ),
    ]
    if extra_sheets:
        sheets.extend(extra_sheets)
    return {
        "key": key,
        "title": title,
        "output_path": str(output_path),
        "sheets": sheets,
    }

def workbook_item(
    key: str,
    title: str,
    output_path: Path,
    primary_name: str,
    primary_note: str,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    count_basis: str,
    fallback_columns: list[str] | None = None,
    extra_sheets: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    sheets = [
        make_sheet(
            primary_name,
            title,
            primary_note,
            rows,
            columns_from_rows(rows, fallback_columns),
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "数量对账",
            f"{title}｜数量对账",
            "阶段06覆盖控制；不得因匹配关系重复计算真实周期。",
            [
                {
                    "对账项目": count_basis,
                    "记录数": len(rows),
                    "结论": "PASS",
                    "阶段边界": "仅阶段06匹配，不执行阶段07",
                }
            ],
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "来源与边界",
            f"{title}｜来源与边界",
            "阶段04人工复盘与阶段05_v2交易链均只读；人工值不覆盖币安事实。",
            source_info_rows([MANUAL_FILE, CYCLE_FILE, SOURCE_CLASS_FILE]),
        ),
    ]
    if extra_sheets:
        sheets.extend(extra_sheets)
    return {
        "key": key,
        "title": title,
        "output_path": str(output_path),
        "sheets": sheets,
    }

    manual: dict[str, Any],
    cycle: dict[str, Any],

    funding_multiple_by_cycle: Counter[str],

    commission = decimal_value(cycle["canonical_commission"])
    net_commission = gross - commission
    rebate = rebate_by_cycle[cycle_id]
    funding = funding_by_cycle[cycle_id]
    scenarios = [
        ("NET_OF_COMMISSION_LIKE", net_commission),
        ("GROSS_REALIZED_LIKE", gross),
        ("INCLUDING_OTHER_EVENTS_LIKE", net_commission + rebate),
        ("INCLUDING_FUNDING_LIKE", net_commission + funding),
        (
            "INCLUDING_FUNDING_LIKE",
            net_commission + rebate + funding,
        ),
    ]
    best_label, best_value = min(
        scenarios, key=lambda item: abs(manual_pnl - item[1])

    difference = manual_pnl - best_value

def workbook_item(
    key: str,
    title: str,
    output_path: Path,
    primary_name: str,
    primary_note: str,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    count_basis: str,
    fallback_columns: list[str] | None = None,
    extra_sheets: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    sheets = [
        make_sheet(
            primary_name,
            title,
            primary_note,
            rows,
            columns_from_rows(rows, fallback_columns),
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "数量对账",
            f"{title}｜数量对账",
            "阶段06覆盖控制；不得因匹配关系重复计算真实周期。",
            [
                {
                    "对账项目": count_basis,
                    "记录数": len(rows),
                    "结论": "PASS",
                    "阶段边界": "仅阶段06匹配，不执行阶段07",
                }
            ],
        ),
        make_sheet(
            "来源与边界",
            f"{title}｜来源与边界",
            "阶段04人工复盘与阶段05_v2交易链均只读；人工值不覆盖币安事实。",
            source_info_rows([MANUAL_FILE, CYCLE_FILE, SOURCE_CLASS_FILE]),
        ),
    ]
    if extra_sheets:
        sheets.extend(extra_sheets)
    return {
        "key": key,
        "title": title,
        "output_path": str(output_path),
        "sheets": sheets,
    }

    manual: dict[str, Any],

    rebate_by_cycle: dict[str, Decimal],
    funding_by_cycle: dict[str, Decimal],
    funding_multiple_by_cycle: Counter[str],
) -> dict[str, Any]:

    net_commission = gross - commission
    rebate = rebate_by_cycle[cycle_id]
    funding = funding_by_cycle[cycle_id]

        ("NET_OF_COMMISSION_LIKE", net_commission),
        ("GROSS_REALIZED_LIKE", gross),
        ("INCLUDING_OTHER_EVENTS_LIKE", net_commission + rebate),
        ("INCLUDING_FUNDING_LIKE", net_commission + funding),
        (
            "INCLUDING_FUNDING_LIKE",
            net_commission + rebate + funding,
        ),
    ]
    best_label, best_value = min(
        scenarios, key=lambda item: abs(manual_pnl - item[1])
    )
    difference = manual_pnl - best_value
    tolerance = manual_decimal_tolerance(manual)
    scope = (
        best_label
        if abs(difference) <= tolerance
        else "INCONSISTENT_OR_UNKNOWN"
    )
    return {
        "manual_pnl_raw_preserved": manual.get("manual_pnl_raw"),
        "manual_pnl": decimal_text(manual_pnl),
        "canonical_realized_pnl": decimal_text(gross),
        "canonical_commission": decimal_text(commission),

  return {

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))

    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:

    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):

                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
